title: Saying your age
summary: Use the English meaning and the Japanese context. Type Japanese, preserving small kana and long vowels.

c01.sentenceGloss: The child is one year old.
c01.note: いち + さい becomes いっさい.

c02.sentenceGloss: My younger sister is two years old.
c02.note: に + さい: にさい.

c03.sentenceGloss: My younger brother is three years old.
c03.note: さん + さい: さんさい.

c04.sentenceGloss: The child is now six years old.
c04.note: For six years old, ろく remains ろく before さい.

c05.sentenceGloss: My elder sister’s child is eight years old.
c05.note: はち + さい becomes はっさい.

c06.note: はたち is the special age word for twenty.
